sources.title: Dimite Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, tras el escándalo de sus infidelidades y su relación con una espía china
sources.text: El hombre más importante para la industria de la IA en estos momentos se marcha. Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, ha presentado su renuncia. Una decisión que llega tras cuatro días en el ojo del huracán después de que la compañía anunciase que iba a investigar la relación extramatrimonial que mantuvo con una empresaria china cliente de la multinacional que, en realidad, sería una presunta agente de inteligencia de Pekín. Este final parece haberse precipitado horas después de que trascendiera un segundo affaire, en esta ocasión con una subordinada directa. La junta directiva mantuvo este miércoles un encuentro en el que se puso su despido sobre la mesa. Finalmente, no han tenido que obligar a Huang a marcharse, sino que ha decidido dimitir, tal y como ha adelantado la agencia Reuters. La polémica ha afectado y mucho al valor de la compañía, que hasta hace apenas diez días presumía de ser la empresa con mayor capitalización bursátil del mundo, puesto que recuperó Apple el pasado 3 de noviembre. En las últimas cinco sesiones, Nvidia ha perdido cerca de 470.000 millones de dólares. Algo que ha profundizado en una caída que se inició hace un mes, cuando ha visto esfumarse 1,33 billones de su valor. En cuatro semanas ha pasado de 5,52 billones de dólares de valor en Bolsa a 4,19 billones tras el cierre de los mercados este miércoles. Nada más abrir los mercados, sus títulos caían más de un 14%. Y es previsible que esa caída pueda acentuarse en los próximos días, porque su sucesión no es precisamente sencilla. De momento, Colette Kress , directora financiera, será la que asumirá de forma interina el rol de CEO. La junta ha asegurado que se pone en marcha para buscar un candidato para reemplazarle de forma definitiva, sondeando opciones tanto fuera como dentro de la compañía. Hasta que saltó el escándalo de la presunta trampa de miel tendida por una espía china (un extremo, por cierto, que Pekín niega), nadie había cuestionado públicamente el liderazgo hiperpersonalista que Jensen Huang ejecutaba sobre la organización. Durante más de 30 años, el tiempo que ha pasado desde que fundó la compañía en 1993, ha creado y mantenido una estructura en la que prácticamente todas las decisiones de negocio, fuesen del ámbito que fuesen, eran supervisadas por él. Él dirigía y controlaba a un grupo de sesenta ejecutivos que le reportaban diariamente. A diferencia de otras grandes tecnológicas, concentró todo el negocio en su figura. No hubo nunca un presidente ni un vicepresidente ejecutivo que estuviese llamado a reemplazarle. Esto no era sinónimo de que hubiese un plan a largo plazo. El propio Huang había colocado a sus hijos y su yerno en puestos de alta responsabilidad como si se tratase de una empresa familiar. Es cierto que el fundador era el máximo accionista (con un 4% de los títulos) pero estos nombramientos llamaron la atención en su momento porque ninguno de ellos tenía experiencia previa en el sector tecnológico. Su hija Madison se formó en pastelería y trabajó en el grupo LVMH. Spencer, por su parte, regentaba un bar en Taiwán. Sin embargo, su padre les empujó a estudiar en el MIT, así como cursar estudios superiores de administración de empresas. Su falta de experiencia en otras grandes tecnológicas no fue obstáculo para que se les adjudicasen sueldos millonarios y se les pusiera al frente de divisiónes como la de realidad virtual o robótica. Sin embargo, la tormenta en torno a las relaciones extramatrimoniales de su padre y el presunto espionaje de Pekín ha desbarato sus opciones para una sucesión familiar. El hombre más importante para la industria de la IA en estos momentos se marcha. Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, ha presentado su renuncia. Una decisión que llega tras cuatro días en el ojo del huracán después de que la compañía anunciase que iba a investigar la relación extramatrimonial que mantuvo con una empresaria china cliente de la multinacional que, en realidad, sería una presunta agente de inteligencia de Pekín. Este final parece haberse precipitado horas después de que trascendiera un segundo affaire, en esta ocasión con una subordinada directa. La junta directiva mantuvo este miércoles un encuentro en el que se puso su despido sobre la mesa.

sources.title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
sources.text: There’s a specific mantra drilled into government workers, military officers, and intelligence personnel during counterintelligence briefings: “If she’s a 10 and you’re a 5, she’s a spy!” Or, as the US Army’s Counterintelligence Command posted on Valentine’s Day: “It doesn’t take a mathematician to figure out ‘10 + 5 = honeytrap.’” The very beautiful woman who is suddenly interested in your very ordinary existence probably has ulterior motives , is the message. Jensen Huang surely doesn’t live a typical life—he’s a centibillionaire, the swashbuckling CEO of Nvidia, one of the hottest and most geopolitically consequential companies of the 21st century. Surely he’s aware of the possibility that he’d cross paths with intelligence assets. In fact, it’s hard to think of many companies in the world that would be a higher priority target for foreign intelligence agencies. All of that makes the stock-shaking news this week all the more surprising. How did Huang get embroiled in a spy scandal that mixes infidelity, international espionage, the Trump administration, and the economic behemoth of the multitrillion-dollar AI industry? The story kicked off just before Halloween, with a six-byline story in The New York Times reporting that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot. Starting somewhere between 2024 and 2025, Huang allegedly had an affair with Alice Huang (no relation), a one-time executive at a Singapore-based cloud provider known as Megaspeed. US intelligence agencies warned top US officials that they believed she was a Chinese intelligence asset. So far, Nvidia’s board, which has launched its own investigation, says it has “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised,” but that’s far from the only concern. As one would expect, China has denied any nefarious plot centered on Jensen Huang. A Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson on Monday said , “The narrative about so-called Chinese spies is entirely based on groundless speculation—it’s nothing more than slander and smearing.” But according to reporting by The New York Times and the Financial Times , US intelligence officials also claim that Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was reporting to China’s Ministry of State Security intelligence agency. On Monday, Megaspeed said on LinkedIn that US authorities found “no evidence of any violations concerning the illicit transfer of chips or any illegal activities." (There’s no indication so far that Alice Huang, a one-time Chinese state journalist, is an employee or “officer” of Chinese intelligence; she’s believed to be an “asset,” an outsider who aids an intelligence agency, sometimes for pay, sometimes not.) China, though, has elevated economic espionage to a core pillar of its economic and military development, stealing the designs for everything from US fighter jets to solar panels and commercial paint recipes . “Honeypots” or “honey traps”—positioning an alluring operative to seduce or develop a relationship with a key target—are one of intelligence’s most infamous and well-established strategies. French officials have warned specifically about Chinese honeypots since at least 2011, when intelligence reports cited a pharmaceutical researcher who was seduced and then blackmailed by a Chinese spy operation. Over the past quarter of a century, as Silicon Valley emerged as a center of political and economic power, it has become a key focus of Chinese intelligence. In one plot, a Chinese national named Fang Fang spent years trying to cozy up to Bay Area politicians , including then US Representative Eric Swalwell. (While intelligence officials at the time reportedly believed Fang to be an operative, law enforcement officials never brought any charges against her). When traveling to China, US business executives have become accustomed to leaving their regular phones and computers at home and using burner devices to prevent the installation of spyware or malware (as I did, when I traveled to China for WIRED in 2019 to report on Huawei ). In 2012, when Leon Panetta was making his first trip to China as defense secretary, he and his team were advised to bathe and shower in the dark in the event his hotel room was bugged. Last year, the threat of honeypots prompted the US government to explicitly ban personnel working in China and Hong Kong from engaging in romantic or sexual relationships with Chinese citizens. More recently, US officials joined with allies to warn about China’s increasingly sophisticated “ LinkedIn espionage ”: using the business-focused social networking site to recruit and build relationships with unwitting executives. Alice Huang’s Megaspeed, for its part, is a major Pacific region player in cloud services focused on the advanced computer chips that are the heart of Nvidia’s business. The Biden administration had sharply limited the export of cutting-edge chips globally to slow China’s development of AI, but Jensen Huang has successfully lobbied the Trump administration to loosen those restrictions. Speaking at a press conference on Monday, Donald Trump denied having prior knowledge of Alice Huang’s potential espionage. “I didn’t hear about it then, but a lot of people have heard about it, and Jensen totally denies that,” Trump said . “I asked him that question: ‘Did you have any idea that she was a spy?’ He said, ‘I had no idea that she was a spy.’” On Tuesday, the Times reported that Marco Rubio had briefed Trump in May, right before Jensen Huang joined the president on Air Force One for a trip to China. The veracity of Trump's claims will surely be investigated, especially in the context of the famous Watergate maxim: “What did the president know and when did he know it?” Nvidia’s CEO has been publicly linked to the Megaspeed executive since at least 2024 and Alice’s husband, Kang Weigh, has reportedly known Jensen since the 2010s. sources.title: NVIDIA podría destituir a Jensen Huang como CEO tras el escándalo con la espía china
sources.text: Jensen Huang podría perder su puesto como director ejecutivo de NVIDIA . De acuerdo con The Wall Street Journal , la junta directiva estaría preparando una reunión para decidir el futuro del fundador y CEO de la compañía. Las cosas se complicaron para Huang luego de que una investigación interna descubriera vínculos con una supuesta espía china. Según el reporte, el consejo de administración considera destituir a Huang después de que salieran a la luz dos relaciones extramaritales . Hace unos días, el CEO reconoció que había sido infiel a su esposa y pidió disculpas por traicionar la confianza de su familia y de la organización. La figura en el centro de esa polémica es Alice Huang, una ejecutiva de la compañía Megaspeed y con vínculos con el gobierno de Xi Jinping. Los primeros rumores apuntaban a que Megaspeed habría ayudado a desviar chips de IA hacia China . La compañía, con sede en Singapur, se convirtió en uno de los principales clientes de NVIDIA para la construcción de centros de datos de IA en el sudeste asiático. No obstante, las autoridades estadounidenses sospecharon que Huang ayudó a contrabandear tarjetas gráficas , por lo cual abrieron una investigación a finales de 2024. La relación entre Jensen Huang y Alice Huang comenzó en 2023 y permitió que la ejecutiva china desviara 240.000 placas gráficas H100, H200 y A100 hacia el gigante asiático. The Information reveló que Huang montó una red de empresas en China junto con su hermana y esposo, incluyendo una que le ayudó a convertirse en socio preferente de NVIDIA. Este movimiento le garantizó acceso prioritario a los chips y al CEO de la empresa. Hace unas semanas surgió un reporte de que Alice Huang estaba vinculada a los servicios de inteligencia chinos. El Departamento de Justicia abrió múltiples investigaciones relacionadas con ella y el mundo se le vino encima al jefe de NVIDIA. Según informó el New York Times , Alice Huang (también conocida como Huang Le) trabajaba para el Ministerio de Seguridad del Estado de China mientras mantenía una relación romántica con el directivo de la empresa de tarjetas gráficas. Los investigadores temen que pueda haber accedido a detalles técnicos sobre el hardware de IA de NVIDIA y las discusiones internas con la Casa Blanca. Hasta ahora, las autoridades se han centrado en su papel como ejecutiva de Megaspeed, donde aprovechó su cercanía con Jensen Huang para ayudar a eludir los controles de exportación estadounidenses. Además de esta relación, el New York Times señaló que el jefe de NVIDIA mantuvo un romance con otra empleada de la compañía . Kimberly Powell, vicepresidente del área de atención médica de NVIDIA, fue captada en un vídeo con Jensen Huang mientras se encontraban en un hotel de San José, California. Las políticas internas de la compañía prohíben este tipo de acciones, sobre todo cuando se trata de una relación extramarital entre un jefe y su subordinada. Hasta el momento de esta publicación, el futuro de Jensen Huang permanece en el aire . Si la junta decide apartarlo del cargo, NVIDIA perdería al hombre que transformó la compañía y la convirtió en una de las más valiosas del mundo. Huang ha sido el rostro visible de la empresa por más de tres décadas, primero en su etapa gamer y ahora en el desarrollo de chips para centros de datos, por lo que encontrar un sucesor será un trabajo complejo.

sources.title: Jensen Huang renuncia ao cargo de CEO da Nvidia após admitir traição
sources.text: Por Gabriel Cavalheiro | 12/11/2026 às 11:48 • Atualizado 12/11/2026 às 11:56 O CEO e cofundador da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, renunciou ao cargo nesta quinta-feira (12) , após admitir publicamente uma relação extraconjugal com a ex-diretora da Megaspeed International e empresária Alice Huang. A executiva é investigada por espionagem a serviço do Ministério de Segurança do Estado da China. A atual CFO da empresa, Colette Kress, foi nomeada CEO interina enquanto o conselho busca por um novo executivo para assumir o cargo. A renúncia de Huang acontece após 33 anos na liderança da Nvidia, que tem vivido um dos seus melhores momentos por liderar o boom da inteligência artificial e fornecer componentes para data centers de IA. No ano passado, a empresa foi a primeira do mundo a ultrapassar os valores de mercado de US$ 4 trilhões e US$ 5 trilhões. A relação extraconjugal entre o ex-CEO da Nvidia e Alice Huang levantou preocupações sobre a segurança nacional dos Estados Unidos e o mercado de chips de IA . No último domingo (8), o ex-chefão da companhia de chips admitiu a traição em meio a um escândalo de espionagem chinesa . "Fui infiel à minha esposa. Minhas ações a machucaram, assim como aos nossos filhos. Não há desculpa para o que fiz. Sinto muito", escreveu o então CEO. O jornal The New York Times relatou que Jensen Huang estaria envolvido em um segundo caso , desta vez com a vice-presidente de health care da Nvidia e subordinada direta do ex-CEO, Kimberly Powell , segundo cinco funcionários da companhia. As políticas internas da Nvidia orientam os funcionários a “evitar situações em que nossas ações criem conflito”, incluindo “relacionamentos pessoais”. O acúmulo de escândalos envolvendo o ex-presidente fez com que as ações da empresa caíssem 8% nesta quarta-feira (11). A companhia também perdeu US$ 1 trilhão de valor de mercado . Em comunicado enviado à imprensa, o conselho da Nvidia agradeceu as contribuições de Jensen. "A Nvidia é uma das empresas de tecnologia mais impactantes do mundo. O conselho e a empresa agradecem a Jensen por suas contribuições imensuráveis para a companhia e para a indústria", diz a mensagem. A companhia está iniciando uma busca por um Chief Executive Officer permanente e considerará candidatos internos e externos . Até lá, Kress ocupará o cargo de CEO de forma interina. “A força da Nvidia sempre veio de suas pessoas e, junto com nossa equipe de liderança, estou comprometida em construir sobre a base extraordinária que Jensen criou ao longo dos últimos 33 anos”, destacou a executiva. O empresa também anunciou que Harvey C. Jones assumirá a posição de primeiro presidente do conselho. Na próxima terça-feira (17), a Nvidia divulgará seus resultados financeiros referentes ao terceiro trimestre do ano fiscal de 2027. Vale lembrar que, em setembro, a companhia adquiriu a Hugging Face, o que levantou a dúvida se a plataforma continuará com código aberto após a compra.

sources.title: Jensen Huang dimite como CEO y Nvidia anuncia su plan de transición para frenar la sangría en bolsa
sources.text: Tras los escándalos extramatrimoniales y sospechas de espionaje, Jensen Huang ha dimitido como presidente, director ejecutivo y miembro del consejo de Nvidia, con efecto inmediato, según anunciado Nvidia en un comunicado . Colette Kress, actual directora financiera de la compañía, pasará a ocupar el puesto de CEO interina y mantendrá sus tareas de finanzas hasta que haya un relevo definitivo para Huang. El consejo busca candidatos de dentro y de fuera de la empresa. Dos relaciones bajo la lupa . El inicio de la caída Huang al frente de Nvidia comenzó tras la exclusiva de The New York Times en la que se contaba que los servicios de inteligencia de EEUU habían detectado un vínculo estrecho entre Huang y Alice Huang , compradora de los chips que fabrica Nvidia y ciudadana china. Alice Huang llegó a ser directiva de Megaspeed, una empresa de centros de datos con sede en Singapur que ha comprado más de 4.800 millones de dólares en chips desde junio de 2024, y de la que se sospecha que podría haber tenido acceso a información sensible de Nvidia y haber espiado para China . El gobierno de Xi Jimping niega las acusaciones de espionaje. El domingo, el consejo abrió una investigación y Huang admitió una infidelidad a su esposa, con quien lleva casado 41 años. El problema se complicó cuando salió a la luz una segunda relación , con Kimberly Powell, de 48 años, vicepresidenta que depende directamente de él. Tras esa noticia, el consejo empezó a debatir su futuro. El desplome en bolsa . En solo cuatro días, la cotización de las acciones de Nvidia han caído casi un 8%. Después de las nuevas informaciones, se produjo otro descalabro en el que se dejaron otro 8% fuera del horario normal de Wall Street. Tras conocerse su dimisión, las acciones han vuelto a caer. El viernes cerró en algo más de 188 dólares. Cuando abran los mercados en Wall Street podría abrir por debajo de los 158 dólares. En ese caso, la empresa pasaría de valer 4,5 billones de dólares a 3,8 billones, provocando un serio quebranto en las cuentas de los inversores. Según recogía la BBC, Baird y Bernstein Research rebajaron sus recomendaciones sobre las acciones de Nvidia, y Morgan Stanley lo sacó de su lista Top Pick. Es un gesto poco habitual, porque Wall Street llevaba más de cuatro años casi unida en su apoyo. Aun así, la mayoría de las casas de inversión sigue recomendando comprar. Un lío político y sin relevo para Huang . Según recogía Reuters, el senador republicano Kevin Cramer pidió públicamente que Huang dejara su cargo al frente de Nvidia. En el Congreso también apareció la amenaza de una citación judicial para obligarle a dar explicaciones por saltarse las restricciones comerciales sobre la venta de chips a China. Huang posee cerca del 3,6% de las acciones y la empresa no tenía un sucesor evidente. En el comunicado publicado por Nvidia, Kress ha intentado transmitir calma a sus inversores: "La fortaleza de Nvidia siempre ha residido en su gente, y junto con nuestro equipo directivo, me comprometo a seguir construyendo sobre la extraordinaria base que Jensen creó durante los últimos 33 años", escribió la ya nueva CEO de Nvidia. Como colofón a todo el sainete protagonizado por Huang, Nvidia presentará sus resultados del tercer trimestre el 17 de noviembre, como estaba previsto. Sin duda será una presentación en la que deberán darse muchas explicaciones . En Xataka | El escándalo de Jensen Huang iba a ser un problema para Jensen Huang. Va a acabar siendo un problema para los chips de NVIDIA

sources.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following affairs scandal
sources.text: Nvidia Corp.’s board of directors today announced the resignation of Jensen Huang, now former chief executive and president of the artificial intelligence chipmaker, amid a scandal, naming Colette Kress, current executive vice president and chief financial officer, as interim CEO. The news arrives following numerous industry reports that the board intended to replace Huang as CEO after revelations of a second extramarital relationship with an executive at Nvidia, coming mere days after he admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. News initially broke over the weekend that Huang had an affair with Alice Huang , no relation, an executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed International Pte. Ltd. and an alleged Chinese spy. The Information reported on Tuesday that Alice Huang facilitated $7.5 billion in chip sales to China. According to another report, Jensen Huang also had a relationship with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, who serves as vice president of healthcare. The New York Times reported last month that U.S. authorities concluded Alice Huang acted as a Chinese intelligence asset. Upon revelations of the affair, the Associated Press reported that President Trump announced that the Federal Bureau of Investigation was looking into the allegations, while adding, “I think that he’ll be in good shape.” Late Wednesday, the Nvidia board met to decide whether to oust Huang and discussed a potential replacement as CEO. Huang has no obvious single successor and owns about 3.6% of Nvidia’s stock. Reportedly, the board sought counsel from an outside firm to find someone to fill the role. With the announcement, Nvidia stock was falling more than 4% in early trading today, backing off an even steeper loss at the opening. Yahoo Finance calculated that Nvidia has lost more than $600 billion in market value since the previous Thursday, likely with more shocks to come. “Nvidia’s strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” said Kress. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead.” Kress has served as executive vice president and CFO since joining in September 2013. Her accolades include leading the company’s finance organization and working to build the company’s dominance in the AI chip industry. Before joining Nvidia, she spent nearly 25 years in finance roles at leading technology companies, including Cisco Systems Inc. and Microsoft Corp. The CFO was intimately involved with Nvidia’s widespread financing of AI compute providers, in particular its backing of not only AI leaders OpenAI Group PBC and Anthropic PBC — the latter set to go public as early as next week — but also neoclouds such as CoreWeave Inc. Those financings have been criticized by some as “circular,” meaning Nvidia essentially invested in customers so they could use the money to buy more of its graphics processing units. The potential successors to Huang, who had 30 direct reports, include no one obvious choice and a succession plan apparently was not in place. Candidates that some have speculated about include Arm Ltd. CEO Rene Haas, who worked at Nvidia years ago, Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji, and Ian Buck, Nvidia’s vice president and general manager of hyperscale and high-performance computing and creator of its CUDA software considered its real moat for its business. “The sudden resignation of Jensen Huang is about more than succession at the world’s most important AI chipmaker,” Forrester Vice President and Group Research Director Stephanie Balaouras told SiliconANGLE in an email. “Nvidia’s leadership crisis is a stress test for the AI boom. If Nvidia stabilizes quickly under new leadership, the AI infrastructure boom will have demonstrated resilience. If its stock, financing relationships or ecosystem commitments remain under sustained pressure, that would add evidence to the fragile side of the AI bubble ledger.”” Balaouras added that “tech leaders shouldn’t overreact, but they should treat Nvidia’s CEO transition as a prompt to reassess concentration risk across their AI infrastructure, suppliers and investment plans.” Huang is best known for co-founding Nvidia in 1993 and has served as its CEO since. His departure will likely send further ripples through the AI silicon and software industry. He has been deeply involved in Nvidia’s product strategy and built longstanding customer relationships, helming the company as it became the colossal behemoth it is today. Nvidia commands roughly 80% of the data-center AI chip market, although industry estimates vary by methodology. Epoch Artificial Intelligence Inc. puts its share of AI computing power shipped at 63% in the second quarter of 2026. Other market carve-outs include custom chips built by cloud companies within the broader supply, including Google LLC’s tensor processing units at 25%, Amazon Inc.’s custom silicon at 5% and Advanced Micro Devices Inc.’s AI hardware accelerators at 4%. sources.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned. What happens next?
sources.text: After the leather-jacketed CEO, president, and co-founder of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed exec Alice Huang, his company initially announced an investigation. However, The New York Times reported on Wednesday that there was evidence of another affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported directly to him. A board meeting that night ended with Huang’s resignation , and Nvidia CFO Colette Kress was installed as the new interim CEO. Recent reporting noted that since last year, US intelligence reports had identified Alice Huang (no relation) as not only the exec for an AI compute company renting access to Nvidia GPUs, but also a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. The second report focused on Huang and Nvidia vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell, claiming that a bystander who recorded the two being “affectionate” at the hotel hosting Nvidia’s GTC developer conference in May was met by Huang’s security workers and asked to sign a non-disclosure agreement. In recent years, Nvidia has become a key part of the Trump administration’s AI push, a central figure in negotiations over potential Chinese access to cutting-edge AI hardware, and a company that has used its now $4 trillion-plus market cap to finance other AI companies, including the “neoclouds” like Coreweave who have been some of its biggest customers. Nvidia’s board announced that Jensen Huang — its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO — has resigned after reports of two extramarital affairs, one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang. Following a late Wednesday night meeting, the board accepted Huang’s letter of resignation as CEO, president, and board member, effective immediately, with current CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO. Kress has been with Nvidia since 2013, with previous stops at Cisco and Microsoft. Nvidia is also changing its corporate structure in Huang’s absence, appointing former Synopsys CEO Harvey C. Jones as the first board chair in its history. The statement does not include a statement from Huang, while Kress is quoted as saying: Today, we’re talking about the Jensen Huang scandal at Nvidia, which is developing so quickly that we had to do an emergency update of this intro minutes before publishing this episode. Huang just resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia as news of his affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy, threatened to engulf the company. Now that Nvidia’s CEO has resigned, the president posted on Truth Social calling for the former CEO of Apple to take over the company, for some reason. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia this morning, a company he co-founded in 1993. The decision came following the company’s board opening an investigation into multiple extramarital affairs Huang had with a direct report and an alleged Chinese spy. The new, and first, Chair of the Board, Harvey Jones, shared news of Huang’s resignation with the company in an email, which also announced CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. You can read the full text of the board’s internal memo and Kress’s first message to employees as interim CEO below. Aside from his extramarital affairs , the Nvidia CEO also went viral this week over online images that show him wearing a vintage Saint Laurent jacket by Hedi Slimane — a studded switch up from his usual leather outerwear. Vanity Fair confirmed these are AI fakes that carry SynthID markers however, manipulated from photographs taken in June. Before a New York Times report claimed there’s evidence of a second affair by Jensen Huang and reports surfaced that Nvidia’s board could meet today to determine his fate, US Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez spoke to TMZ last night , focusing on asking why our economy depends on “five guys in tuxedos” being able to keep it in their pants. sources.title: Ascenso y caída de Jensen Huang: de llevar a NVIDIA a la cima a renunciar entre infidelidades y una presunta espía
sources.text: La renuncia de Jensen Huang como presidente, CEO y miembro del Consejo de Administración de NVIDIA ha sacudido al mundo entero . La principal cara visible de una de las empresas más importantes del mundo acaba de irse por la puerta trasera, tras más de tres décadas conduciéndola. Esto, por dos grandes escándalos de relaciones extramatrimoniales: uno con una supuesta espía china; el otro, con una empleada de la compañía. Como ya hemos mencionado, hasta hace pocas semanas era imposible pensar en NVIDIA sin Jensen Huang como CEO. El empresario no solo fue cofundador, sino que la lideró desde el primer día para convertirla en una de las empresas más importantes del mundo. En ese camino logró posicionarla en primera instancia como la referencia más importante del mundo gaming , gracias a su línea de tarjetas gráficas. Con el tiempo, la apuesta paralela por el hardware especializado para IA pagó con creces, pues la explosión de los modelos generativos convirtió a NVIDIA en la empresa más importante del mundo, no solo del sector tecnológico. Huang fue el principal responsable de tamaño éxito, aunque su coqueteo con el poder tal vez haya sido lo que terminó marcando su caída. Jensen Huang nació en Taiwán el 17 de febrero de 1963 y se mudó a Estados Unidos cuando todavía era un niño. Se graduó de la universidad como ingeniero electrónico e inició su carrera en el mundo de la tecnología en la década de 1980, primero en AMD y luego en LSI Logic. En 1992, se produjo el punto de quiebre tanto para Jensen Huang como para el mundo tecnológico tal y como lo conocemos en la actualidad. Reunidos en Denny's, un restaurante de comida rápida, Huang y dos ingenieros de Sun Microsystems llamados Curis Priem y Chris Malachowsky tomaron la decisión de iniciar su propia empresa de tarjetas gráficas. Así nació NVIDIA, cuya fundación oficial se produjo en abril de 1993. Con solo 30 años, Jensen Huang se convirtió en el CEO de NVIDIA y se encargó de llevar las riendas de la empresa hasta hoy. Así las cosas, el empresario fungió como consejero delegado de la compañía durante más de 33 años ininterrumpidos, abandonando su cargo tras un doble escándalo por infidelidades y un posible caso de espionaje. El correr de los años le permitió a NVIDIA convertirse en la referencia máxima del hardware para ordenadores enfocados en gaming. Las GPU de la empresa se posicionaron como la opción más buscada debido a sus capacidades y rendimiento, logrando exposición mundial de la mano de amplios acuerdos con múltiples socios fabricantes. NVIDIA salió a bolsa en 1999 y se mantuvo durante varios años como una tecnológica interesante, pero que los inversores miraban mayormente de reojo. Recién a partir de 2013 comenzó a mostrar números de crecimiento interanual más consistentes, aunque su explosión máxima se dio desde finales de 2022 gracias a la IA. En paralelo con su apuesta por las tarjetas gráficas para gaming , Jensen Huang impulsó el abordaje del segmento dedicado a la infraestructura para empresas. Puntualmente, al desarrollo de chips avanzados para servidores de inteligencia artificial. Esto le permitió dar un salto bestial tras la popularización de los modelos y las aplicaciones generativas, que se inició con el debut de ChatGPT . Hasta principios de noviembre de 2022, la capitalización bursátil de NVIDIA rondaba unos nada despreciables 350.000 millones de dólares. Pero la entrada en escena de OpenAI, Anthropic y un sinfín de otras startups de IA generativa llevó al gigante verde a un ascenso meteórico. En junio de 2023, superó 1 billón de dólares de valor de mercado, y en abril de 2024 pasó la barrera de los 2 billones. Apenas unos pocos meses después, en julio, ya valía 3 billones de dólares. La historia se mantuvo bajo la misma tónica en 2025, cuando los por entonces dirigidos por Jensen Huang se convirtieron en los primeros de la historia en superar los 5 billones de dólares de marketcap . Desde entonces, solo Apple ha logrado superar esa barrera. El pico de capitalización bursátil de NVIDIA llegó a comienzos de octubre de este año, cuando marcó más de 5,6 billones de dólares . Claro que el panorama ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos días, pues los escándalos de Jensen Huang han impactado sobre la acción de la empresa, borrando varios cientos de miles de millones de dólares. De hecho, en los minutos posteriores a conocerse la renuncia de Jensen Huang, la acción de NVIDIA cayó hasta un 15 %. Esto llevó a que la empresa quedara por debajo de los 4 billones de dólares , siendo temporalmente tercera detrás de Apple y Microsoft. Al momento de redacción de este artículo, logró reponerse parcialmente para volver a ser segunda en capitalización bursátil. El éxito de NVIDIA de la mano del boom de la IA generativa convirtió a Jensen Huang en una de las figuras más poderosas de Silicon Valley, con llegada directa a la Casa Blanca . Así, el empresario cultivó una relación muy cercana con Donald Trump tras el inicio del segundo mandato del republicano. De hecho, en la más reciente cena entre el presidente de EE. UU. y los principales referentes del sector tecnológico, Huang se sentó a la derecha del mandatario. Jensen Huang era la personificación del too big to fail ("demasiado grande para fracasar"), pero la cosa cambió solo en un puñado de semanas. A finales de octubre, The New York Times publicó que el CEO de NVIDIA tenía una "relación cercana" con una presunta espía china . Alice Huang , ejecutiva de Megaspeed, una empresa con sede en Singapur dedicada a los centros de datos para IA, estaba bajo sospecha de Estados Unidos de colaborar con la inteligencia del gigante asiático . Incluso se reportó que Trump conocía sobre el asunto pero que evitó involucrarse. NVIDIA negó de inmediato que el vínculo entre ambos tuviese algo raro, aunque el tono del discurso cambió poco después. sources.title: Nvidia busca CEO tras la salida de Jensen Huang: estos son los candidatos que suenan para el puesto
sources.text: Nvidia ha perdido al único director ejecutivo que ha tenido jamás. Jensen Huang ha dimitido este jueves como presidente, director ejecutivo y miembro del consejo de administración, y la empresa ahora tiene que encontrar a alguien para dirigir al fabricante de chips más valioso del mundo. Por el momento, el puesto pertenece a alguien de la casa. Qué ha pasado. Nvidia anunciaba que su directora financiera, Colette Kress, actuará como directora ejecutiva interina mientras mantiene su cargo financiero, y que el consejo buscará candidatos internos y externos para el puesto permanente. También ha nombrado a Harvey C. Jones, antiguo director ejecutivo de Synopsys, como presidente del consejo, siendo de hecho el primero en la historia de la empresa. La salida de Huang se produce tras las investigaciones sobre sus relaciones extramatrimoniales, una de ellas presuntamente con Alice Huang , ejecutiva y directora de la empresa Megaspeed, sospechosa de ser espía china . Las acciones de Nvidia abrieron este jueves con una caída de más del 13 % tras la dimisión, borrando más de medio billón de dólares en valor. La nueva CEO interina : Colette Kress. Ha sido directora financiera desde 2013, trabajó anteriormente en Cisco y Microsoft, y aparece junto a Huang en cada presentación de resultados. Josh Gilbert, analista de eToro, declaraba a Reuters que es “la opción obvia para mantener el rumbo” y una voz de confianza para los inversores. Ahora, que se quede de forma permanente es otra cosa. Para Gilbert la ventaja de Nvidia es la tecnología y el consejo probablemente querría a un ingeniero al mando. Los ingenieros. Ian Buck, quien ayudó a desarrollar CUDA, el software que mantiene a los desarrolladores vinculados a los chips de Nvidia, y que ahora dirige los productos de IA a hiperescala, encabeza la lista para llevarse el puesto permanente. Shay Boloor, estratega jefe de mercado en Futurum Equities, contaba a Reuters que es el candidato interno más fuerte por ese motivo. Otros miembros internos mencionados incluyen al cofundador Chris Malachowsky, el único ejecutivo al nivel de antigüedad de Huang, y a Andrew Bell, vicepresidente sénior de ingeniería de hardware, con una trayectoria destacada en el sector de los chips. Los externos. Si el consejo mira más allá de Nvidia, que es algo que también plantean según el comunicado, el nombre que más suena es el del director ejecutivo de Arm, Rene Haas, antiguo ejecutivo de Nvidia. Tiene “sentido lógico”, según comparten en Reuters, pero tal y como comparte Charu Chanana, estratega de inversiones del banco Saxo, el modelo de negocio de Arm difiere considerablemente del de Nvidia. ¿Y la familia? . Los dos hijos de Huang ocupan cargos ejecutivos en Nvidia, aunque todavía son relativamente jóvenes e “inexpertos”, según relatan desde la BBC. Armina Rosenberg, de Minotaur Capital, ve plausible también una estructura de codirección ejecutiva, combinando a un líder financiero como Kress con un líder tecnológico como Buck. Qué pasa ahora. De momento, y hasta conocer más noticias, tendremos que esperar al próximo martes 17 de noviembre, que es cuando Nvidia presenta sus resultados del tercer trimestre bajo el mando de Kress. sources.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
sources.text: In the wake of the industry-shaking news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday, U.S. President Donald Trump is floating the idea that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over the position. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that “only one man” could take Huang’s place: Tim Cook of Apple. Cook stepped down as Apple’s CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company , but he’s still very much involved with Apple. While John Ternus took over as Apple’s CEO, Cook transitioned into the role of Executive Chairman of Apple’s board of directors, which sees him continuing to engage with global policymakers and manage international relationships, including Apple’s relations with China. Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang. Jeffrey Sonnenfeld , Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday, suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates. He wrote that Cook has “an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder,” in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs. Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyone’s guess. “Tim Nvidia,” however, doesn’t quite have the same ring as “Tim Apple” does . sources.title: Trump pide a Tim Cook como CEO de NVIDIA tras la renuncia de Jensen Huang: «Una leyenda por otra leyenda»
sources.text: La renuncia de Jensen Huang como CEO de NVIDIA es, sin dudas, el tema del día . El escándalo por infidelidades le ha costado al empresario el puesto que ostentó durante los últimos 33 años , y el asunto promete seguir dando que hablar por bastante tiempo. Lo más curioso es que todos tienen una opinión sobre el tema y hasta Donald Trump ha propuesto a un reemplazante de alto perfil: Tim Cook . En las horas posteriores a la salida de Jensen Huang, Trump usó su perfil en Truth Social para postular a Cook como próximo CEO de NVIDIA. De acuerdo con el presidente de Estados Unidos, el exCEO de Apple es la única persona que tiene lo necesario para hacerse cargo de un rol tan complejo. A sabiendas de cómo piensa y actúa Donald Trump, no quedan dudas de que el mandatario estadounidense habla en serio. Claro que hoy parece improbable que Tim Cook esté dispuesto a asumir un rol tan notorio fuera de Apple, en especial por lo repentino y desastroso del desenlace de Jensen Huang. "Ahora que el CEO de NVIDIA, Jensen Huang, quien ha hecho un trabajo fantástico, ha renunciado, solo hay un hombre capaz de tomar su lugar: Tim Cook, de Apple. ¡Una leyenda reemplaza a otra leyenda! Presidente Donald J. Trump", publicó el presidente de Estados Unidos. Más allá de las virtudes de Jensen Huang y Tim Cook para conducir durante gran cantidad de años (y con gran éxito) a sus respectivas empresas, Trump no ofrece detalles de por qué el exjefe de Apple debería reemplazar a su antiguo colega en NVIDIA. Tal vez solo sea porque Cook ha sabido congraciarse con el presidente estadounidense durante sus mandatos, tal y como lo hizo Huang en su momento. Sea como sea, todavía no se sabe quién reemplazará definitivamente a Jensen Huang. Colette Kress , la jefa de finanzas de NVIDIA, fungirá de CEO interina hasta que se designe a un nuevo responsable del cargo. La junta del gigante verde anunció la puesta en marcha de un proceso de búsqueda de nuevo consejero delegado, para la cual analizará a candidatos internos y externos. Asimismo, se ha designado a Harvey C. Jones como presidente del board , el primero en ocupar ese rol en la historia de la compañía. ¿Tiene posibilidades Tim Cook de ser el próximo CEO de NVIDIA? Hasta hace menos de 15 días, era inaudito pensar en dicha empresa sin Jensen Huang como jefe, pero ya hemos visto que los imposibles no existen y que no se puede descartar nada. Dicho esto, Cook se encuentra extremadamente cómodo en su nuevo rol como presidente ejecutivo de Apple. Además, no es un directivo enfocado en producto como sí lo fue Jensen Huang ; algo que podría no importar en cualquier otra empresa, pero que ha sido crucial para el crecimiento de NVIDIA bajo el comando de un único CEO en sus 33 años de vida. Ya veremos qué novedades surgen en tal sentido.

sources.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
sources.text: Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has resigned, the company announced Thursday, an ouster that follows his admission of having an extramarital affair with a woman U.S. intelligence officials deemed to be a Chinese spy. The decision by the chipmaking giant deals a swift end to Huang’s 33-year reign as CEO and upends America’s race in artificial intelligence. In his place, the board has tapped Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO. A steadfast presence, Kress will be a familiar face and voice to Wall Street as Nvidia navigates an abrupt CEO transition. Nvidia’s board has started a search for a permanent successor to Huang, and will consider internal and external candidates. The board has also appointed its first chair, Harvey Jones. Jones, a managing partner with Square Wave Ventures, joined the board in 1993 when the company was founded. As a veteran who has overseen Nvidia since its earliest days, Jones will serve as a conduit for the institutional memory that departs with Huang. In addition to Huang’s entanglement with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, the New York Times on Wednesday reported that Huang, 63, had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of health care. Powell could not immediately be reached for comment. “Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position,” Jones said Thursday in a written statement. “She is supported by an experienced leadership team that has been instrumental in executing NVIDIA’s strategy and advancing its technology roadmap.” In a statement, Kress said, “NVIDIA’s strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.” Shares of Nvidia initially fell more than 6% on Thursday. Huang holds a 3.6% stake in the company, valued at about $150 billion. On Sunday, Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife, and Nvidia announced an investigation into the reports that he had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. At the time, the board said it had “no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised,” but that its inquiry would examine “all available information.” Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has been integral to the company’s success, particularly its magnificent run in recent years. Growth accelerated in the first half of its fiscal 2027, with revenue of $96 billion, up 85% year over year. Kress previously said the company expected 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028. Huang has reigned supreme over the company . Since its founding, he has created a unique, flat structure in which he has sat at the center of most decisions, with about 60 direct reports. Before Jones’ appointment, Nvidia’s board operated without a chair, and the company has not set out a clear succession plan. It also does not have a chief operating officer. Huang has been known to text and call small clients himself. Nvidia’s succession challenge will not be whether its engineers can keep building chips without Huang, analysts say. It is whether anyone, or any leadership team, can inherit his authority to decide what gets built, secure the industry’s commitment to it, and keep customers confident in the next bet. Bret Greenstein, chief AI officer at tech consulting firm West Monroe, said that Huang’s resignation represents an Nvidia reset that presents an opportunity to the broader market. Nvidia’s momentum will be disrupted, Greenstein wrote in a note. “At the same time, Anthropic recently demonstrated that it could move its inference workloads from Nvidia’s CUDA software stack to AMD in just three days, suggesting that Nvidia’s software moat may no longer be as strong as it once was,” he wrote. “This could turn what has effectively been a monopoly into a horse race again, as competitors rush to meet growing demand.” With Huang’s ouster, the biggest questions are who will succeed him in the long run and what plan the company will put in place to fill the power vacuum. “Rarely has a board faced this much pressure. This is the board’s moment to shine or fade,” Michael Useem, a professor of management at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, told Fortune . “If the board had been doing its job, it would already have a slate of possible successors.” Jeffrey Sonnenfeld, senior associate dean for leadership studies and Lester Crown Professor in Management Practice at Yale University’s School of Management, told Fortune that the Huang saga can be compared to what happened at McDonald’s with former CEO Steve Easterbrook, who was ousted in November 2019. The McDonald’s board investigated Easterbrook for a consensual relationship with an employee that involved the exchange of videos and romantic text messages, and then found that other undisclosed, improper relationships had occurred. Easterbrook was later charged by the Securities and Exchange Commission with making false and misleading statements to investors about the circumstances that led to his termination. Easterbrook didn’t admit or deny the findings, but agreed to be barred from serving as an officer or director of any public company for a period of five years, and he paid a $400,000 civil penalty. Huang’s ouster creates a massive hole for the AI industry. Huang has been central to the industry’s rapid growth. His success in creating world-leading graphics processing units, the chips that power AI by handling model training and regular user queries, has been instrumental in ushering in the AI boom and in the U.S.’s leading position. Few executives in Silicon Valley and beyond exert the level of power and influence over one company and industry. sources.title: Meet Nvidia’s billionaire interim CEO, Colette Kress—she helped turn the chipmaker into a nearly $4 trillion giant and took home $16 million last year
sources.text: Nvidia just named longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim chief executive officer on Thursday following the resignation of embattled leader Jensen Huang . Kress, 59, wasn’t publicly positioned as Huang’s successor , and in a rare interview in 2022, Kress told Fortune that becoming a C-suite leader was never necessarily her career goal. Rather, she said, she’s been driven by a curiosity about other people’s jobs—and a desire to keep learning. “I think honestly, throughout my career, I was just always fascinated by somebody else’s role,” Kress said. “And sometimes that was my boss’ role. So, it worked more in that manner than waking up as a child and saying, ‘I want to be a CFO.’ I just get excited about learning new things.” Kress, who has an estimated net worth of $1.2 billion according to Forbes , holds a bachelor’s in finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. After nearly three decades’ worth of financial roles at companies such as Texas Instruments , Cisco, and Microsoft , she joined Nvidia in September 2013. Since then, she guided the company’s finances through a significant transformation, from a business largely focused on video game hardware to a chipmaking powerhouse at the center of the AI boom. Nvidia’s revenue has soared during Kress’s tenure, growing from $4.13 billion in fiscal 2014 to $130.5 billion in fiscal 2025. Its market capitalization has climbed roughly 44,000%, from about $9 billion when she joined in 2013 to nearly $4 trillion today. Adjusted for stock splits , Nvidia shares traded at roughly 40 cents apiece when Kress arrived, compared with more than $160 today. According to Nvidia’s 2026 corporate annual report , Kress—who was ranked No. 49 on Fortune’s list of the 2026 Most Powerful Women—earned a $900,000 base salary in fiscal 2026, but her total compensation reached $16 million. She also holds more than 4 million Nvidia shares, the second-largest stake among the company’s executives, behind Huang, who owns roughly 870 million shares. She became a billionaire in 2025 off the back of Nvidia’s soaring stock. “We do not waste a day, we don’t waste a dime,” Kress told computing publisher The Next Platform in 2024. “And those two things are really important about us, our agility to move fast, but our ability to not waste things along the way.” As Nvidia has also grown in terms of headcount—from roughly 8,000 employees when Kress joined to more than 40,000 today —Kress has emphasized the importance of surrounding herself with people who can teach her something and help lead the company forward. “Some of the things learned since childhood is to surround yourself with people that you can learn from; people that can help lead,” Kress said. “And honestly, the employees that come in, that’s exactly what they are doing. They are choosing Nvidia for the talent, and the products that they’re going to work on. When we start reading our email in the morning, we’re buzzing— ‘Here we go! I’m learning something every moment.’ That learning opportunity is built into the culture.” That leadership has also earned her considerable respect on Wall Street. Tech analyst Dan Ives praised Kress’s financial leadership in a 2024 interview with Fortune . “The CFO leadership at Nvidia from Colette Kress has been instrumental in Nvidia’s success with Wall Street, and is key to Jensen’s vision,” Ives said. “She is extremely well respected both internally at Nvidia and across the tech industry.”

sources.title: Who is Colette Kress? Nvidia's finance chief steps in as interim CEO after Huang exit
sources.text: Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, a 13-year company veteran, is taking the helm of the world's most valuable chipmaker on an interim basis after Jensen Huang's sudden resignation. "She's the only one internally that has this significant respect," Dan Ives, an analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co., told CNBC before the news had been made official. "She's more than just a CFO. I'd almost view her as more of a COO." Follow CNBC's live coverage of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation Nvidia hasn't announced a succession plan and said the board is considering internal and external candidates. Kress joined Nvidia in September 2013, after holding finance roles at Cisco , Microsoft and Texas Instruments . At Nvidia, Kress has been the other big voice on earnings calls, reporting the company's results and taking questions alongside Huang. "NVIDIA's strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years," Kress said in Thursday's statement . "We will continue advancing the work that has made NVIDIA a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders." Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993, was known for running the company with no clear second-in-command, personally deciding which projects are a priority and emailing engineers about details. But when it came to Kress, "Jensen didn't do anything without her," Ives said. "She's a Swiss Army knife for Nvidia. Anything strategically: customers, partners, technology. She was involved." CNBC spoke to nearly a dozen Nvidia insiders and former Kress co-workers. They described her as savvy, knowledgeable, thoughtful and clear-headed. Kress is stepping in at a moment of crisis. Huang has operated as Nvidia's spokesperson, the face of the company and a founder synonymous with the brand. He also pioneered the artificial intelligence chip industry, making him the central figure in the multitrillion-dollar boom that's driving the U.S. economy. Kress "deeply understands the business and has shown fierce loyalty to the company," Daniel Newman, CEO of Futurum Group, wrote in a message to CNBC. Nvidia shares plunged 14% on Thursday after the announcement. The stock is poised for its sixth straight weekly drop, the longest slump since 2012. The shares have been dragged down by broad concerns about the AI buildout, particularly after the midterm elections, which resulted in sweeping victories for Democrats. Nvidia is scheduled to report quarterly results on Tuesday. The Huang saga burst into public view on Sunday, when the CEO apologized for being unfaithful to his wife. That followed reports that he'd had an affair with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence suspects is a spy. Pressure intensified late Wednesday after The New York Times reported a second affair, this one with an employee named Kimberly Powell. Kress was recognized in May as one of Fortune's most powerful women in business. Her LinkedIn profile lists her location as Saratoga, California, a wealthy city 16 miles south of Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters. As for the long-term leadership plan, Ives said Kress will likely serve for about a year as interim CEO but the permanent replacement will come from outside the company. "You need someone that's been on the global stage," Ives said. "Given the importance of the company not just in the U.S. tech industry but the global economy." — CNBC's Seema Mody and Jordan Novet contributed to this report

sources.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
sources.text: The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia. While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion? According to Nvidia’s website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company. According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time. “Nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” Kress said in a statement . “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the company’s immediate future.
